overview: The meeting addressed the spatial requirements for the Career and Technical Education (CTE) programs at Medford High School. Officials explained that state guidelines and high enrollment necessitate expanding, rather than shrinking, these learning spaces.

items.title: Career and Technical Education Space Requirements
items.summary: Officials discussed how high student enrollment and Department of Elementary and Secondary Education standards require larger square footage for CTE programs, such as the culinary kitchen, to maintain safety and compliance.
